I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0453569
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.

Main Asset:
Y2 / R9 313202799103
Charger ID / Serial No.: 9y7glZ
Charger address/functional location: Monaco
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Please proceed with the replacement of the HMI. Here are the MLFBs:
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1 - Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/o AC cutoutControlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/o AC cutout
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8​​​​​​​8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8 - Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR​​​​​​​Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 - Adaptation set
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.

Calin Lenei
